summary: Iteration 5 — Notifications + Admin EOD summary/email tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest GREEN in /app/backend/tests/backend_test_v5.py covering: (a) POST /api/notifications/refresh returns {created:int>=0} and re-running does not duplicate manager-scope aggregate types (dedupe_key logic verified: team_overdue/stale_lead/negotiation_pending/exec_no_activity counts stable across refresh), (b) role-scoped listing: admin sees admin+manager+personal; manager NEVER sees role_scope=='admin'; executive priya only sees notifs with user_id==her.id and none of the manager-scope aggregate types, (c) POST /notifications/{id}/read decrements unread by 1 and flips read=true; POST /notifications/read-all zeroes unread for the caller, (d) POST /leads with assigned_to=priya spawns lead_assigned notif visible to priya with meta.lead_id matching, (e) POST /follow-ups spawns followup_due notif with meta.followup_id, (f) GET /admin/eod-summary as admin returns full schema {date, generated_at, followups.{due_today,overdue}, milestones.{bookings,new_leads,site_visits_completed}, calls.{total,connected,missed,talk_time_sec}, top_execs:list}; manager & executive both get 403, (g) POST /admin/eod-email/send admin returns {sent,errors[],date}; errors[] shape validated (each entry has email+error keys); manager+exec 403, (h) regression: /dashboard/monthly, /dashboard/revenue-breakdown, /leads, /projects, /follow-ups, /site-visits, /twilio/status, /users, /auth/me all 200. Frontend Playwright: (1) admin login → EOD modal AUTO-OPENED at local time 19:xx (>=18:00) → localStorage key 'tasko-eod-shown-2026-07-15' set to '1' → dismiss button removes it. (2) NotificationBell renders in topbar with red badge; after refresh created=15 notifs, dropdown shows 4 recent items + Mark-all read button. Clicking mark-all zeroed the badge. (3) Admin ACTION ITEMS tab (dash-tab-actions) shows dash-eod-card. Send-now button triggered POST /admin/eod-email/send → 200 with sent=0 (Resend testing-mode limitation, expected per spec) → frontend showed toast 'No admin recipients found.' (see MINOR issue below). (4) Manager login: no modal, no card on action-items tab, /notifications returns only role_scope in (null, 'manager') — never 'admin'. (5) Executive priya: no modal, no card; /notifications only returns items with user_id==her.id AND none of the manager-scope aggregate types; mark-all still functional. Screenshot verified Priya's dropdown showing 'Follow-up due today', 'New lead assigned', 'Site visit tomorrow' — all personal.

minor.issue: When Resend returns an error for a non-verified recipient (testing mode), the errors[] array is populated but 'sent' stays 0. That is per-spec, but there is no aggregate 'errors' count separate from sent — a client cannot easily tell '0 admins' from '3 admins all bounced'. Consider adding tried/attempted count to distinguish.

Uses lexicographic string comparison on 'created_at' ISO strings for sort and 24h dedupe window. Works because now_utc() always emits UTC ISO with same timezone offset — but if any historical row has a different TZ suffix, the dedupe window becomes inaccurate. Consider storing datetime objects and using Mongo Date type.

The dedupe_key uses 'today_start.date()' bucketing (UTC) — so an admin in IST checking at 04:30 IST (23:00 UTC previous day) will see 'yesterday-UTC' aggregates dedup twice. Minor: bucket by IST or user timezone if that matters.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast copy 'No admin recipients found.' is shown whenever r.data.sent===0. But sent===0 can happen for TWO reasons: (a) no admin users, or (b) Resend rejected all recipients (errors[] non-empty). Right now Resend testing-mode failures are misleadingly labelled 'no recipients'. Suggest: if (data.errors?.length) toast.error(`Email failed for ${data.errors.length} admin(s): ${data.errors[0].error}`) else if (sent===0) toast.warning('No admin recipients found.').

issues: DialogContent renders without <DialogDescription> — same Radix a11y warning as iteration 4: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Also affects other dialogs.
Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings still logged on first render — carried from iteration 4.

action_items: [Medium] Fix misleading EOD send-email toast — differentiate between sent=0-because-no-admins and sent=0-because-Resend-errored. Read data.errors[] and surface the first error message to admin so they know the domain isn't verified.
[Low] Add <DialogDescription> to the EOD modal DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2614 lines — the notifications block (~230 lines) and EOD block (~230 lines) are prime candidates to move into routers/notifications.py + routers/eod.py + services/eod_email.py. Especially _eod_html() (72 lines of inline HTML) belongs in templates/.

create_notification() dedupe is O(N) per call because it hits Mongo with a find_one for every candidate. On refresh_notifications() this means ~2 queries per follow-up. For a tenant with 500 pending follow-ups + 200 site visits, one refresh call = ~1400 Mongo round-trips. Add a compound index on (dedupe_key, user_id, role_scope, created_at) OR batch-check dedupe keys with a single $in query at the top of refresh_notifications().

refresh_notifications() always returns created = number of create_notification() *calls* — not number actually inserted (dedupe-skipped calls also increment 'created'). This is why the test above shows created=15 even after the second identical refresh. Fix: only increment when actually inserted (have create_notification return bool).

AdminEODSummary.jsx uses `now.toISOString().slice(0,10)` for the localStorage day key — this is UTC date, not local. So an admin in IST logging in at 00:30 IST (19:00 UTC previous day) will use YESTERDAY-UTC as the key, meaning the modal could re-open twice on the IST 'same day'. Use local date components instead: `${now.getFullYear()}-${(now.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')}-${now.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0')}`.
resend Emails.send is called via asyncio.to_thread which is fine, but there is no per-call timeout — if Resend hangs the endpoint hangs too. Wrap in asyncio.wait_for with a 10s timeout.
SENDER_EMAIL defaults to 'onboarding@resend.dev' which is Resend's test sender. Once the domain is verified this MUST be updated in backend/.env — flag this in deployment checklist.

rca_of_the_issue: No bugs blocking the sprint. The one MEDIUM-priority frontend UX issue (misleading 'No admin recipients found' toast when Resend rejects all recipients) has clear reproduction: as admin, click 'Send now' on the EOD card while Resend key is in testing mode with an unverified recipient — backend correctly returns {sent:0, errors:[{email,error}]} but the frontend collapses that into the 'no recipients' message. Fix by checking data.errors.length first in AdminEODSummary.jsx sendEmail().
